description: This file defines a PHP class 'Shipping' within the Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Total namespace. The class handles shipping-related actions such as calculating quotes, saving shipping information, and managing shipping methods for the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: A controller class managing shipping calculations, quotes, and address handling within the OpenCart total extension namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of shipping options and address form, interacts with session data and configuration to prepare shipping info.

methods.name: quote
methods.description: Returns JSON with shipping quotes/options based on current session and post data. Validates shipping address and calculates available shipping methods.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves shipping address and selected shipping method into session, and removes payment method/session data for changes.
